name: cconami
description: Skills, subagents, hooks and mods for agent-driven work: Linear workflow, product shaping, skill and subagent authoring, a multi-session operating model, and Claude Code interface mods.

plugins.name: linear-workflow
plugins.description: Linear project-management skills: refine, break down, analyze and execute work items, and keep projects organized.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product skills: workshop PRDs, prioritise features, write product overviews, and brainstorm designs.

plugins.name: authoring
plugins.description: Authoring skills and subagents: build skills and subagents, scrape documentation, configure Ralph.

plugins.name: operating-model
plugins.description: How agent sessions work with each other and the owner: checkpoints, owner asks, isolated PR review, workstream leads, peer coordination, and a command guard hook.

plugins.name: owner-inbox
plugins.description: The Linear issues waiting on you, in a band above the prompt and a panel toggled with /inbox, in every session.

plugins.name: peer-messages
plugins.description: Messages from other Claude sessions, agents and channels, drawn as a card in the chat.

plugins.name: ci-status
plugins.description: The GitHub CI state of the current branch, and of the PRs this session opened, in a band above the prompt. Hidden when GitHub cannot be read.

plugins.name: mcp-health
plugins.description: A band above the prompt when a plugin's MCP server is not connected, naming the server and the next step.

plugins.name: guardrail-notice
plugins.description: A card in the chat and an entry above the prompt when a hook refuses a tool call, so work blocked on you is not missed.
